StoryContent.SourceString:
对于星绘来说，母亲曾经是自己的“引航的星星”，她的期许就是自己成长的动力。而母亲也以身为女儿的榜样为傲。为了让星绘更好的成长，母亲忘我地工作，积攒一切可用的资源。一切都是为了让女儿通向自己幻想中的那个光辉的未来。
在还是孩子的星绘眼中，母亲聪慧、强大，虽然忙碌但从不疏于指导女儿成长。受益于母亲辛苦积攒下的资源，星绘能比同龄人更早地培养自己的兴趣，接受优质教育，也拥有更多选择的自由。
当星绘第一次表现出对天体和宇宙的兴趣后，母亲就带着她来到了欧泊设立的大型天文台——这里是母亲工作的场所。
凝望着女儿摆弄精密仪器，手法笨拙，却似乎又无师自通的模样，母亲说出了星绘此后的人生无法忘却的那句话——
“星绘，你要去成为那颗在夜空中最为闪耀的星星。” 
此后，在母亲的指引下，星绘入学、读书、跳级进入大学，再以优异的成绩提前毕业，最后如愿以偿地进入了欧泊。
而就在同年——“崩溃”的前兆，已经悄然发生。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
To Celestia, her mother was a guiding star, the beacon whose expectations always pushed her to strive for greatness. In return, Celestia's mother took pride in being a role model for her daughter. She worked tirelessly, sacrificing her own needs to ensure Celestia's bright future—her ultimate dream.

Young Celestia admired her mother as a wise and powerful figure. Though often busy, her mother always found time to guide her. Thanks to her mother's dedication, Celestia discovered her interests sooner than others, enjoyed a quality education, and had the freedom to choose her own path.

When Celestia first expressed a fascination with the universe, her mother brought her to a large observatory operated by P.U.S, her workplace.

Watching her daughter awkwardly yet intuitively explore the precise instruments, Celestia's mother spoke the unforgettable words:
"Celestia, you must become the star that shines brightest in the night sky."

The ensuing years flew by. Under her mother's guidance, Celestia started school, skipped a grade, entered university, graduated early with top marks, and finally joined P.U.S.

That same year, the first whispers of The Collapse emerged.

StoryContent.SourceString:
首先是小规模的、区域化的意识模糊现象被反馈在居住区的常规医疗档案中。作为管理机构的“欧泊”十分重视这些报告，及时指派了救助人员。
然而这些救助几乎没有取得任何效果。就在医疗界尚在争论不休时，“崩溃”开始大规模爆发了。
当时，作为“欧泊”的一员，星绘也参与了相关的救助工作，却对“崩溃”束手无策。
随着“剪刀手”组织的登场，正式引爆了“新世界”积累的所有矛盾。
对现状开始感到迷茫的星绘求助于母亲——此时的母亲已经就职于欧泊的高层部门——母亲的回答，是让星绘继续钻研最前沿的学术和人脉经营。为关心太多无关紧要的人和事分心，是她最不愿意在女儿身上看到的。
去成为最闪耀的那颗星星吧，星绘！
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
First came a localized wave of confusion and delirium reported by medical check-ups in residential areas. As the responsible agency, P.U.S attached great importance to the reports and promptly assigned personnel to assist.
But these efforts bore few results. As the medical community was still locked in debate, the outbreak of The Collapse began.
As a member of P.U.S, Celestia had been part of the relief team but found herself just as helpless in the face of The Collapse as her colleagues.
The appearance of The Scissors only worsened the situation as they lit a fire under all the contradictions of this “new world.”
Her heart, confused by all that had unfolded, Celestia turned to her mother, who was now a high-level P.U.S executive, for help. The answer she received? Delve deeper into the latest cutting-edge studies and operational management techniques. Being distracted and worrying about the unimportant was the last thing she wanted for Celestia.
Go on, and shine like the brightest star!

StoryContent.SourceString:
无论当时是基于怎样的想法，是对母亲长久以来精心呵护与培育的反叛，是看到学术研究面对苦难爆发的局限性，以及自己缺乏行动的焦虑，甚至包括自己对这片宇宙茫然无知……
星绘也无法从自己纷杂的思绪中得出一个准确答案。也许都并存于自己的心中吧。
总而言之，星绘离开了欧泊，离开了母亲的身边。
她基于自己先前寻访和救助“崩溃”患者时的实践经验，总结出了一套“意识修复”医疗方案，再用积蓄开办了“星庇所”，就此开始帮助一些寻医无门的患者。
话说回来，原本一直致力于天文和宇宙学相关研究的自己，为什么会忽然投身于这样的工作？一向头脑清晰的星绘一时也给不出答案……
偶尔，星绘能感受到内心中有一个声音在质询自己。
……
星庇所在勉力维持了一年后，因为资金不足而倒闭了。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
No matter her reasons, her actions directly rebelled against her mother's years of care and guidance. Facing the outbreak of suffering, the limits of academic research, her anxiety over inaction, and even her ignorance about the universe...
Celestia couldn't find an answer within her heart. Perhaps she had to accept these feelings coexisting.
So, Celestia left P.U.S and her mother's side.
With her experience in identifying and treating Collapse patients, Celestia created the "Consciousness Restoration" project. She soon used her savings to open Astral Sanctuary, helping those with nowhere else to turn.
But why did she, always more interested in astronomy and cosmology, suddenly dedicate herself to this work? Celestia usually had all the answers, yet this question lingered.
Sometimes, Celestia heard a voice from within questioning her.
...
A year later, lacking funds, Astral Sanctuary had to close.

StoryContent.SourceString:
几位访客为星绘提供了一线希望：乌尔比诺联合财团的新医疗产业部门正在开展最新一轮的投资活动。
如果想办法将“意识修复”作为一个新医疗项目推荐给乌尔比诺，至少能够解决资金方面的燃眉之急。
这几位患者曾经表现出轻至中度不等的意识崩溃前兆，幸亏有星绘及时介入，锚定了他们的自我意识，控制了病情。
如果由他们出面证明“意识修复”医疗方案的疗效，或许能够顺利地获得一笔投资。
有了访客的推荐，星绘与乌尔比诺投资机构的洽谈过程短暂且顺利。她的项目第一次获得了较为正式的认可。
值得一提的是，星绘顺便参观了乌尔比诺财团的总部（此后她将多次来到这个地方），参观了关于“向多维宇宙进发”的计划。
不知为何，星绘感觉不到自己对这个计划的任何兴趣，所以几乎没有参与乌尔比诺设立的相关开发项目。她依旧守护着自己小小的星庇所，过着沉默而忙碌的日子。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
A few visitors offered Celestia a glimmer of hope: Urbino's new healthcare arm was making a new round of investments.
If she could find a way to get Urbino to buy into her “Consciousness Restoration” project, funding would no longer be a concern - at least in the short term.
These visitors had been former patients of hers. When they started showing mild signs of Collapse Syndrome, Celestia was able to intervene in time and tether their consciousness to reality.
If they were willing to come forward to prove the efficacy of her treatment, she was sure that Urbino would give her the funding she needed.
The recommendation of a former patient got her foot through the door, and negotiations proved short and sweet. For the first time, Celestia's project had received formal recognition.
During negotiations, Celestia visited Urbino's HQ (she would return there many times in the future) and was invited to take a look at their Multiverse Project.
For whatever reason, she didn't feel any interest in participating. To this day, she still dutifully watches over her restored Astral Sanctuary, living a silent but busy life.

StoryContent.SourceString:
——“星绘姐姐，为什么我的爸爸和妈妈忽然不记得我了？”
一位被送到星庇所的小患者曾经向星绘提出这个问题。而那时星绘是如何回答的？
孩子无法理解复杂的“意识崩溃机制”，他们所能观察到的现象，就是自己身边的某个人会忽然性情大变，随后开始和亲人发生无休止的争吵、摩擦和冲突。一个曾经热闹的家庭完全解体。
与孩子不经遮蔽的观察及切身的痛苦相比，任何试图缝合伤口的话语都是无力的。
所以，那时星绘根本给不出答案。她知道，那些孩子的父母亲还活着，但是身为崩溃症患者，他们几乎已经是另外一个人了。而这些孩子呢？他们的未来又该如何呢？
所以，星绘能做的就是尽力安抚好小患者们的意识状况。看着入睡后的孩子们的小脸蛋，想象着他们的意识深处的“伤痕”，能通过自己的双手和话语，一点一点地愈合。
乌尔比诺的投资解决了一些资金问题，但星绘仍然缺乏同伴，只能加大工作强度，加班熬夜成了家常便饭。为此，星绘每天都要调配星芒咖啡——一种苦甜交织，提神醒脑的饮料——慢慢的，这成了她小小的乐趣之一。
星庇所的名字渐渐地不再鲜为人知，接受过星绘帮助的人亦不会遗忘她的温柔。但星绘依旧形单影只。
直到“引航者”的出现……
被患者们视为“星星”的星绘，也将会迎来属于自己的“第一颗星”吧？
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
- "Celestia, why don't Mom and Dad remember me anymore?"
The question came from a young patient at the Astral Sanctuary. Celestia contemplated how to respond.
Children can't grasp the complexities of Collapse Syndrome, but they can see its effects. Someone close to them might suddenly change, becoming argumentative and causing endless quarrels and tension within their family - a once-happy home now shattered.
Faced with the child's pain, Celestia felt that any reassurance would be powerless to ease his wounds.
She knew his parents were alive, but afflicted by Collapse Syndrome, they were like strangers. What would become of the children left behind? What future awaited them?
Celestia was determined to soothe the minds of the young ones in her care. As she watched them sleep, she imagined healing their deep mental scars, bit by bit.
Urbino's funding resolved her financial concerns, but Celestia still lacked dependable partners, leaving her to shoulder more work. Early mornings and late nights became routine. To stay alert, she created a drink she dubbed Starlight Coffee—a bittersweet, refreshing brew that became a small daily joy.
The Astral Sanctuary gradually earned a reputation. Those who experienced her care would never forget Celestia. Yet, she remained alone.
At least, until the Navigator entered her life...
Perhaps Celestia, regarded as a "star" by her patients, will finally receive a "star" of her own?

StoryContent.SourceString:
“游戏伙伴，说好了，一定要平安回来啊~”
“嗯，玩家之间从不爽约！”
每次搜查官乔治·李外出执行任务时，父女之间都会进行这样的告别。
玩家之间约定好的事情，不能反悔，不能缺席。
每次外出执勤，父亲都会遵守约定准时回来，陪伴女儿体验她最爱的游戏——《NO.1的正义英雄》。坐在家庭电视前相约着玩游戏，是父女之间为数不多的共处时光。
父亲操控主角“火力大喵”，女儿配合操作主角的搭档“喵喵卫士”，父女二人组共同对战邪恶的魔龙。
想要以最快的速度通关游戏，往往需要不惧险阻的勇气、敢于突破的创新精神，这一点逐渐形成了米雪儿特有的“玩家思维”，由此，她成长为一名游戏好手。
她会不自觉地把这种思维代入到现实生活中，做事风格大胆跳脱。
开明的父亲非常支持女儿的做法，他鼓励米雪儿勇敢尝试任何她想做的事情。
“遵循自己的内心，勇敢无畏地尝试，这才是玩家的风格。”
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
"Promise me, partner, that you'll return in one piece!"
"You got it. A gamer always keeps their promise!"
Every time Investigator George heads out on a mission, this is the little send-off he shares with his daughter. A gamer’s promise is set in stone, no backing out, no skipping out.
Whenever duty calls, he always makes it home in time to dive into their cherished game together—Superheroes of Justice. Their gaming sessions on the family console are some of the rare moments they share.
With Dad commanding the fiery powerhouse Mighty Meow, and his daughter as the trusty sidekick Pawtector, they team up to take down the sinister demon dragon. Speedrunning the game calls for a mix of bravery and creativity, cultivating Michele's unique "gamer mindset" and molding her into an epic gamer.
Without even realizing it, Michele brings that gamer mindset into her everyday life, adopting a bold and unconventional approach to things.
Her open-minded father supports her adventurous spirit, encouraging her to fearlessly chase whatever her heart desires.
"Follow your instincts and dive headfirst—that's the true gamer's way!"

StoryContent.SourceString:
在《NO.1的正义英雄》里，两位主人公时常需要挺身而出，同被魔龙蛊惑的怪盗团伙、亡命恶徒斗智斗勇。
在这些对战中，米雪儿遭遇到的“变装怪盗”、“电锯连环杀手”、“怪人弗兰肯斯坦”都有一种无比熟悉的感觉。这些反派的原型似乎都是父亲已查处捕获的要犯。
在某个卡关的下午，米雪儿在“NO.1的游戏论坛”查询攻略时，发现了一个讨论主角“大喵”原型的热帖。
这个热帖极其严谨地论证了“大喵”的原型正是破获了无数悬案疑案的搜查官——乔治·李。论坛里的游戏玩家无一不在称叹这位传奇一般的搜查官英雄。
在那一刻，米雪儿的内心深处萌发了此生最强烈的愿望。
当晚，父亲一如既往从任务中归来，米雪儿望着那身帅气的制服与闪耀的徽章，同父亲约定：“我要成为和你一样的正义英雄！”
父亲像从前那样轻抚她的额头，不经意间发现，这个小丫头似乎已经长大了。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
In Superheroes of Justice, the protagonists often clash with a host of nefarious foes—from the elusive Phantom Thief to the relentless Chainsaw Killer, and the mysterious figure known only as Frankenstein. Michele finds these adversaries eerily familiar, reminiscent of the notorious criminals her father has captured.
One afternoon, stuck on a challenging level, Michele turns to the Superheroes of Justice forum for tips. There, she stumbles upon a lively thread discussing the inspiration behind the character Mighty Meow. The post meticulously argues that the legendary Investigator George Lee—solver of countless mysteries—is the true inspiration behind Mighty Meow. The forum buzzes with admiration for this real-life hero.
In that moment, the strongest wish Michele has ever felt ignites within her heart. That evening, as her father returns from another mission, she looks up at him in his dashing uniform and makes a vow: I will become a hero of justice, just like you!
As he gently ruffles her hair, he suddenly realizes his little girl is starting to grow up.

StoryContent.SourceString:
从搜查官学院毕业后，米雪儿报名了欧泊搜查官考试。实战考试期间，她不按常理出牌，频频出人意料。
她以最快的速度完成了考试，但中途屡次遭到监考官的黄牌警告。
沮丧的米雪儿以为自己没有通过考试，回家的时候脏兮兮的小脸像只花猫。
就在她以为自己无缘英雄梦时，父亲告知了她通过考试的消息，并为她送上了一份特殊的礼物——两只战术机器猫。
它们是父亲曾经的侦查机器人，经过战术升级后，成为了米雪儿的战术伙伴。米雪儿分别给它们起名为“火力大喵”和“喵喵卫士”。
米雪儿活用游戏中汲取的灵感经验，举动大胆出格，在同一批新人中非常“出名”。她的“玩家思维”也让她显得格格不入，她经常因为违反纪律被人训斥排挤。
“英雄的女儿也不过如此……”
“不守纪律的搜查官真差劲！”
质疑与讽刺之声如潮水般涌来，刚成为搜查官不久，一粒自我怀疑的小小种子在少女的心中种下。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
After graduating from the Investigator Academy, Michele signed up for the P.U.S. Investigator Exam. During the practical test, she played by her own rules, constantly defying expectations. She completed the exam at lightning speed but not without earning several warnings from the proctors.
Convinced she had failed her dream of becoming a hero, the frustrated Michele returned home, looking like a dirty tabby cat. Just when she was about to give up hope, her father shared the unexpected news—she had passed the exam. He also presented her with a special gift: two tactical robo-cats.
These had once been his reconnaissance bots, now upgraded for tactical operations, becoming Michele’s new partners. She affectionately named them "Mighty Meow" and "Pawtector."
Inspired by her favorite game, Michele’s bold and unconventional moves made her stand out among fellow rookies. However, her "gamer mindset" made her stick out like a sore thumb, drawing criticism and exclusion for breaking the rules.
The whispers of doubt and sarcasm surrounded her:
"So much for being a hero's daughter..."
"Undisciplined investigators are an embarrassment!"
These voices of doubt and scorn surrounded Michele, planting a small seed of insecurity in the heart of the new investigator.

StoryContent.SourceString:
“这一次大概要很久以后才会回来……”
“很久是多久？……无论如何，我等你回来！”
这是父亲崩溃以前，父女间最后的道别。那天下起了大雨，父亲走得很匆忙，神色严峻。
与往常不同，他没有许诺回来的时间。接连数日的暴雨笼罩了埃利蒙德，远方久久没有传来关于父亲的消息。
不知又过了多少天，暴雨稍稍停歇，米雪儿收到了一通来自搜查科的电话，对方转告了父亲遭人所害而罹患崩溃症的消息。紧接着父亲的职务被搜查科暂停。
米雪儿始终坚信，父亲是因为伤病才被暂停职务，但是关于父亲非议的杂音不绝于耳。
如同《NO.1的正义英雄》里所演绎的，英雄未能实现正义就倒下了，从任务中归来的父亲陷入了重度昏迷。
隔着病房的玻璃窗，米雪儿重复着一天天的等候，但父亲完全没有苏醒的迹象。
一直元气阳光的少女脸上，仿佛有雨滴滑落……
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
"This time, it'll be a long time before I can return..."
"Just how long is that...? Don't worry. No matter what, I'll be waiting for you!"
These were the last words exchanged between Michele and her father before everything fell apart. On that rainy day, her father left in a hurry, his expression grave. Unlike usual, he gave no promise of when he'd return. Days of unrelenting rain engulfed Elmond, but no word came from afar about her father.
Eventually, what felt like an eternity passed, and the storms eased just a little. Michele received a call from the Investigation Bureau. They informed her of her father's plight—he had been attacked and had fallen victim to Collapse Syndrome. His duties were suspended indefinitely.
Michele steadfastly believed her father's suspension was due to injury, not misconduct. However, the whispers of gossip and slander were relentless.
Just like in Superheroes of Justice, where a hero falls before fulfilling their mission, her father returned from his assignment in a deep coma. Michele stood vigil by his side, day in and day out, waiting without a glimmer of awakening.
The ever-cheerful girl now seemed to have rain falling from her eyes, mirroring the sadness she felt inside.

StoryContent.SourceString:
对自己的嘲讽质疑、对父亲的歪曲污蔑，这些嘈杂的声音从未消停。
那场带走父亲意志的暴雨似乎也未曾停歇。
女孩在无助与迷茫中久久彷徨。
每每陷入迷惘中，米雪儿总会躲在自己的“秘密基地”。在一个普通的雨天，猫咖店没有开张。米雪儿独自在街头徘徊。
一声绵软的猫叫声响起，是那两只机器猫咪在呼唤自己。出于担心，两只机器猫咪在冰雨中寻找它们久出未归的主人，因电量将要耗尽而瘫倒在地。
米雪儿蹲下身，突然，两只小猫握住了米雪儿的双手，机械猫爪传递过来久违的温暖。
像是划开了一道口子，愈来愈多的温暖涌入。
从预备队员转为正式的搜查官后，她的这份“不甘服输”与“出人意料”为自己吸引了一群珍贵的伙伴。
慢慢地，雨停了，天空投下了一束温暖的阳光。
到底应该做一个怎样的搜查官？父亲案件的真相是什么？
尽管此刻，少女的内心仍然在纠结……
但是，就像《NO.1的正义英雄》续作那样，失去大喵的“喵喵卫士”又开启了新的冒险，她知道她也应该前进了。
那些不确定的答案，就去未来寻找吧！
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
Those who ridiculed and questioned her, and those who slandered and spread rumors about her father— their cacophony never ceased. The storm that had stripped her father of his will seemed unending. Michele wandered aimlessly, trapped in helplessness and confusion.
In such times, Michele often retreated to her "secret base." On one ordinary rainy day, with the cat café closed, she found herself wandering the streets alone.
A soft meow broke the silence—her two loyal robo-cats were calling for her. Concerned, they'd braved the freezing rain to find their long-absent owner, and now lay powerless, drained of energy.
Michele crouched down, and suddenly, the two robotic paws clasped her hands, spreading warmth she hadn't felt in ages. It was as if a fire started in her palms, and with each passing moment, more warmth rushed in.
Transitioning from a rookie to a full-fledged investigator, her unyielding attitude and unpredictable ways drew a group of cherished comrades to her side.
With each day, the rain eased a bit more until, finally, a warm ray of sunlight pierced through the sky.
"What kind of investigator should I be? What's the truth behind my father's case?"
Though her heart still wrestled with these questions, she knew, just like in the sequel to Superheroes of Justice, where Pawtector embarks on a new adventure even without Mighty Meow by their side, she too needed to move forward.
She would only find the answers to these questions by facing the future with a smile!

StoryContent.SourceString:
“我将高傲不屈，纯洁不朽……”
年幼的奥黛丽向着纯白的独角兽家徽立下誓言。
作为一名格罗夫家族的成员，特别是格罗夫当家人的女儿，她从小就被教导，要始终优雅，永葆高洁，不要轻易地屈服低头。
奥黛丽的童年时光被严苛的父母安排得满满当当，每一天她必须完成十多门课程的学习，包括马术、谈判、金融、音乐、舞蹈……
她总是能以超乎同龄人的成长速度接纳这些专业知识。
家族的荣耀与责任或许过于庄严而高大，但在奥黛丽看来，她并不会把这些东西视作压力与负担。
独自一人的时候，望着手里的徽章，她由衷地希望自己身上也能迸发出高洁的光辉。
或许是任性，亦或许是作为女儿的小小愿望，在忙完所有的课程之后，她会拉上父母开一场音乐茶话会。这是她对父母的唯一要求。
咖啡、巧克力，配上小提琴曲，一家人欢聚一堂，这样的茶话会才是完整的。
当琴弓与琴弦共振齐奏时，动听悠扬的旋律响起，女孩仿佛被一片纯白的光芒笼罩。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
"I shall stand proud and unyielding, pure and eternal."
Young Audrey pledged these words to the Grove's ancestral crest—a pure white unicorn. As the patriarch’s daughter in the esteemed Grove family, she was groomed to uphold elegance and nobility, never to yield easily. Her childhood was meticulously crafted by her strict parents, filled with over ten daily lessons—from equestrianism to finance, negotiation, music, and dance.
Audrey's rarefied talent enabled her to master these fields at a pace unmatched by her peers. What others might find a burden—the honor and duty of the Grove name—she saw as a beacon of potential. Alone with the family emblem in her hand, she dreamt of radiating such noble brilliance.
Driven by willfulness or perhaps a daughter's heartfelt wish, Audrey cherished musical tea gatherings with her family. Coffee, chocolates, and the soothing melody of the violin completed these moments. As the bow danced upon the strings, an angelic harmony enveloped the room, revealing Audrey suspended in a pure white glow.

StoryContent.SourceString:
作为休诺·格罗夫的独生女，奥黛丽十多岁的时候就跟着父母参与企业管理。
格罗夫家族传续数百年，在金融银行、股票证券、汽车制造、能源开发等诸多领域都能瞥见独角兽的身影，其中的利益网络也错综复杂。
奥黛丽所要面对的是整个商业帝国的荣光与阴暗。
在商业合作中她被竞争对手反复中伤坑害，这使得她对人与人之间的真心产生质疑，她习惯性地将家族以外的关系排除在真情之外。
由于早年积攒了大量的管理经验，奥黛丽很早的时候时候就成为了父亲的管理副手。每次家族聚会，父亲都会带奥黛丽出席。
酒席之上，盛装的少女与那么多同族聚会共餐，虽然她深知人心莫测，但在内心深处，她仍旧对亲情抱有一丝期盼。
“奥黛丽，成人礼快乐！往后你将会收到一份特别的礼物！”
奥黛丽的亲叔叔布莱兹·格罗夫如是祝福道。
奥黛丽与这位长辈碰杯，以示敬意。她带着纯粹美好的愿望期待着那份礼物，
她却无法预知，在碰撞的酒杯下隐藏着怎样的阴谋。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
As the only child of Bruno Grove, Audrey was ushered into the world of business by her early teens. With a family legacy stretching over centuries, the Grove family boasted a complex web of interests across banking, securities, automotive manufacturing, energy, and more.
Audrey faced the dual challenges of living up to her family's illustrious name while navigating the empire's shadows. Entering the business arena, she encountered relentless slander and conspiracies from rivals, which eroded her trust in others. She realized that to endure, she must rely solely on her family's strength.
Her extensive experience from a young age quickly propelled her to become her father's right-hand, faithfully attending every family assembly by his side. Draped in luxurious attire, she mingled with her kin, understanding the fickle nature of human hearts, yet clinging to a flicker of hope for genuine family bonds.
"Audrey, happy coming-of-age! I'm sure greater gifts await you in the future!" her uncle, Blaise Grove, declared.
Audrey raised her glass to his in respect, looking forward with sincere anticipation to the promised gift. Unbeknownst to her, beneath the surface of this toast lay unseen conspiracies.

StoryContent.SourceString:
“人心无以预料，亲情坚不可摧。”
起初奥黛丽与父亲一样坚信，同族的血亲绝对秉持着一样的高洁伟岸。
外界谣传布莱兹·格罗夫觊觎家主之位已久，奥黛丽不会轻易怀疑自己的亲人，但随后发生的事情远超出她的预料——
公司的执行部长被暗杀，父母受到人身威胁，公司的营收状况一落千丈。
随即，以布莱兹为首的格罗夫们纷纷倒戈，他们向竞争对手低价抛售股票，致使格罗夫家的资产大量流失。
奥黛丽与父亲站出来主持大局，安抚人心，却无人响应。父女二人声嘶力竭的演说换来的只有白眼与嘲笑。反对者们云集，他们发起公投重选当家人，父女二人被无情地驱逐。
那场公投过后，奥黛丽的心中立下了一堵戒备的高墙，父母之外的人都不可信赖。
为了留存家族基业，奥黛丽宣布公司退市，并且不断挖掘新的商机。
此时格罗夫家族早已四分五裂，外界或许认为这会是格罗夫家族的落日。但只有奥黛丽知道，真正的格罗夫从不会轻易低下高昂的头颅。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
"People's hearts are unpredictable, but our family ties are indestructible."
Audrey once shared her father's conviction that those who bore their family name would strive to uphold its nobility and dignity.
Despite whispers that Blaise Grove coveted the role of family patriarch, Audrey refused to suspect her kin—until reality unfolded beyond her expectations.
The company's executive director was assassinated, her parents' lives were threatened, and the corporation plunged into crisis.
In a calculated move, Blaise's faction defected, offloading stocks to competitors at cut-rate prices, causing vast financial repercussions for the family.
When Audrey and her father tried to rally and stabilize the family, their appeals were met with cold stares and disdain. Their adversaries seized the moment, called for a re-election, and mercilessly ousted the father-daughter pair.
This betrayal solidified Audrey's resolve, deepening her distrust of anyone outside her immediate family.
Determined to safeguard the remnants of their business, she announced the company’s delisting and vigorously explored new ventures.
While outsiders might see the Grove legacy fading, Audrey knows that a true Grove never bows easily. The spirit she embodies remains proud and unyielding, pure and eternal.

StoryContent.SourceString:
商业之都纽特朗中林立着瑰丽璀璨的摩天大楼，有朝一日，奥黛丽渴望在这里筑起更加恢弘雄伟的建筑，在上面铭刻上象征格罗夫家族的独角兽。
她往后的道路注定孤独，尽管有一众家族旧部以报恩为由，愿意追随奥黛丽，奥黛丽却无法相信他们。
进军纽特朗后，奥黛丽迅速瞄准了高端商城领域，她深入发掘，并与强大的商业联盟“乌尔比诺”建立合作。很快，新生的格罗夫在纽特朗立稳根基。
奥黛丽与同族只保持着商业上的往来。居高临下，冷若冰霜，令人望而生畏，这是家族成员对该时期奥黛丽的全部评价。
尽管如此，格罗夫们无一不认可奥黛丽的才能，关于新一任家主的人选，奥黛丽的呼声达到了顶峰。回想起父亲的遭遇，奥黛丽全然不在乎他们的拥护与支持。
然而，长久高压地操盘商业以及对旁人设防，使得她的身心受到了极大损耗，她终于还是支撑不住病倒了。
在被送入医院时，她最后睁眼看到的有泪眼婆娑的父母，还有一群陌生的同族。
她在内心深处对双亲呐喊，不要相信那些人，那些人从不值得信任……
随着她身体的状态抵达了极限，她闭上了双目。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
As the region's commercial capital, Neutroville boasted an array of magnificent, awe-inspiring skyscrapers. Audrey envisioned a day when she would construct an even more majestic tower, adorned with the Grove unicorn.
Her journey was destined to be solitary. Though there were Groves eager to follow her lead, Audrey found herself unable to trust them any longer.
Audrey’s first strategic move in Neutroville was to enter the luxury retail sector. By forging an alliance with the powerful business group "Urbino," she swiftly established the Grove family's presence in the city.
Her interactions with her relatives became strictly business. To them, she was known as a formidable, ice-cold force—intimidating and authoritative.
Audrey’s undeniable talent invoked a chorus of support for her as the next Grove family leader, though she was indifferent, never forgetting how they once turned against her father.
But the unrelenting pressure of the cutthroat business world and her constant vigilance took a toll on her health, leading to a grave illness.
As she was rushed to the hospital, her last sight was of her parents’ tear-filled eyes and a group of strangers bearing her name. From deep within, she silently screamed, "Don't trust them. They're unworthy."
As her body finally gave in, she closed her eyes.

StoryContent.SourceString:
悠扬的音符温暖地包裹着她，失去全部记忆的少女从一片黑暗混沌中醒来。
一对夫妇坐在自己周身，远处一个同龄的女孩演奏着小提琴曲。但那些遥远而又温暖的音符却又马上消散了。
“你们是什么人？”懵懂中的少女发问。
“我们……都是你的家人。”那对夫妇回答道。
她的病房外站满了很多人，他们的胸前佩戴着一枚独角兽勋章。这似乎是一个大家族？
随身听、骨瓷制咖啡杯、《话语的螺旋角》精装版……听说这些都是“奥黛丽”最珍爱的东西。
她带着这些与“奥黛丽”相关的旧物走访亲友，不断去寻找与“奥黛丽”相关的记忆碎片。这趟旅途非常漫长，但她坚持了下来。
复苏后的她比此前更加投入工作，她主动肩负起守护整个家族的责任，甚至决定参选下一任乌尔比诺的盟主。
繁忙的事务又回到她的身边，但这次似乎有所不同，家族内部对于她的回归议论纷纷。
破碎的镜子难以复原，收集记忆再次拼凑出的“奥黛丽”还是原来的那个她吗？
她感觉自己如同童话故事中的困兽，在孤独的森林里，没有任何一个同伴……
如果能够追逐那温暖的音符，走出森林……少女将这个小小的心愿埋藏在心底。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
As melodious notes wrapped her in a warm embrace, the amnesiac girl awoke from her dark slumber.
Opening her eyes, she saw a couple sitting nearby and a girl her age playing the violin in the distance. Yet, those warm notes quickly faded away.
"Who are you?" she asked, confusion welling up inside her.
"We... we're your family," the couple gently replied.
From the glass window, she noticed many others gathered outside her room, all wearing unicorn badges—an indication of a large family, perhaps?
Among the items said to be "Audrey's" treasured possessions were a personal stereo, a bone china coffee cup, and a hardcover edition of The Spiral Dynamics of Speech....
With "Audrey's" belongings in hand, she embarked on a search, visiting relatives and friends to reclaim fragments of her lost memories. The journey was long and arduous, yet she persevered.
Upon recovery, she threw herself into her work with renewed vigor, shouldering the responsibility of safeguarding her entire family and even aspiring to lead Urbino.
Though old challenges resurfaced, this time, everything felt different. Whispers within the family corridors spoke of her return.
But could a shattered mirror be truly restored? Was this "Audrey," pieced together from scattered memories, the same person she once was?
She felt like a character in a fairy tale, a creature lost in a lonely forest with no allies. If only she could chase after that warm melody, to find her way out of the dark woods... This small wish remained locked deep within her heart.

StoryContent.SourceString:
拉薇年幼时就跟随父亲修习武道，继承了父亲的流派衣钵。
她十年如一日地在武馆庭院中磨练刀术，院中的竹子已然成为她最熟悉的伙伴。每一株竹子上面刻满拉薇挥刀的痕迹。从它们还是竹苗时，拉薇就对着它们练刀。
长大后，拉薇的刀愈发凌厉如风，一呼一吸之间，被平整切开的竹叶如雨般落下。拉薇的身手令无数门徒称叹，甚至诸多师兄师姐也不是她的对手。
尽管如此，拉薇也不甘满足，她永不停歇地打磨自己。或许对于她来说，她本身就是一柄刀。
旧地球时期的拉薇醉心武道，沉浸在只有刀光与竹影的世界中，唯独和父母保持日常交流，由此她逐渐形成了沉稳内敛、寡言少语的性格。
“总是形单影只的可怜孩子”、“以刀为友的古怪武痴”，这是武馆同门对少年时期拉薇的最常见评价。拉薇并不在意这些声音，当时的她只听得见竹叶的沙沙低语。
风又吹了起来，庭院里竹影摇曳，且听风吟，挥刀斩破！
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
Having studied the art of budō with her father from a young age, it was only natural that Lawine inherited the mantle of his teachings.
For ten years, she's been honing her skills with the blade. She and the bamboo that grows in the dojo courtyard share an unspoken bond. Each bamboo carries the mark of her blade - they've been her training partners since they were just little saplings.
As she grew older, Lawine's blade became as sharp as the wind. With a single breath, she could cut through bamboo leaves like a hot knife through butter. Her skills became legendary among the dojo's disciples. Even working together, they were no match for her.
But Lawine never grew complacent. She would continue honing herself, day after day. Perhaps she thought of herself as a blade - in need of constant sharpening.
During the days of old Earth, Lawine had a singular focus - budō. She immersed herself in a world where only the reflection of her blade and the shadow of her target were real. Her only contact with the outside world was her parents. From this, she developed a reserved and taciturn character.
Much was said about Lawine by the other disciples. “A poor, lonely child.” “A strange fool whose only friend is her sword.” But she didn't care about that. The only sound that mattered to her was the gentle rustling of bamboo leaves.
The wind has picked up once more. Shadows sway through the courtyard. Just listen to the wind, and be firm when you draw!

StoryContent.SourceString:
旧世界的灾难全面袭来，拉薇家的武馆由于长年无人光顾而倒闭，门人们各自逃难。而她的父母因为扛不住那年最冷的寒潮而长眠地下。
拉薇孤身一人在末世中漂泊了很久很久，她不知道这样的生活还将维系多久……
“卡拉彼丘将是人类栖居的新家园，那里蕴含着无限可能，不再有贫困疾苦，不再有分裂剥削……”残破的街巷反复播放着这样的广播。
新家园吗？拉薇无法理解，因为她已经没有家了。
越来越多的难民将希望寄托在一个名为“卡拉彼丘”的新世界，一股移民热潮掀起。一无所有的拉薇投身其中。
由于敏捷的身手和一身独到的刀术，拉薇被新世界政府分配到搜查局任职，她的新身份是一名欧泊搜查官。
此外她还撞见了一个性格与自己截然相反的话痨搭档，对方总是喜欢找她比试挑战，屡战屡败，屡败屡战。虽然是个很麻烦的家伙，拉薇却不完全讨厌她。
“这次就比一比谁先到那个位置吧！”
在第2614次比试时，她还是输给了拉薇。
“看啊，是夕阳，好温暖啊！——”
拉薇回过神时，夕阳已将她们完全包裹。
心中好像有什么不一样了，拉薇觉得自己找到了一点家的感觉。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
As calamity struck old Earth, the Lawine dojo became barren as its disciples fended for their lives. Lawine's parents did not fare any better, claimed by the worst cold snap the world had ever seen.
Lawine became a wasteland wanderer. Lost and aimless, she had no idea what the next day would bring.
“Strinova will be humanity's new home. A land of infinite possibilities. One with no poverty, suffering, division, or exploitation...” These broadcasts played incessantly in old Earth's run-down streets.
A new home? Lawine had lost hers long ago.
One after another, the desperate masses pinned their hopes on this “new world.” An influx of refugees started flooding into Strinova. With nothing left on old Earth, Lawine threw herself in with their lot.
Lawine's nimbleness and skill with a blade earned her a place in the Sentinel Bureau. She would serve as an investigator under Painting Utopia Security.
During her time at PUS, she made acquaintances with a chatty colleague who seemed to be the opposite of her in every way. That person had a penchant for issuing challenges, and no matter how many times Lawine would defeat them, they would always be up for another round. Though quite troublesome, the truth was that Lawine didn't mind her that much.
“Let's see who can reach the objective first!”
Challenge 2614. Another win for Lawine.
“Look! The sunset! It feels so warm...”
By the time Lawine collected herself, the sunset had already completely enveloped them.
Something seemed to have changed in her. As Lawine stared into the distance, she felt that she had found a new home.

StoryContent.SourceString:
入职搜查局以来，拉薇始终保持着最早执勤、最晚离岗的考勤记录，任务战绩名列前茅。拉薇觉得，这里为她提供了新的归处，自己这柄刀就该任其驱使。
“正义，英勇，坚毅，为了守护美好的理想乡而战！”拉薇时刻铭记着这句搜查官训诫，这一度成为了她执刀的理由。
在一次次执行任务中，她惯用的木刀甚至彻底损坏。小话匣子搭档见状赠送了一柄新匕首。
“热烈庆祝搜查官拉薇上任一周年——”
“而且你看，我也有一把，是一对哦！”
拉薇全然不在乎这件事，她只惦记着下一次任务的执行时间。但是拉薇难以拒绝搭档的盛情邀请，在休息日，二人再度相约科莫斯塔下，眺望夕阳。
拉薇以为这样的时光能一直持续下去……
不知从何时起，话匣子搭档突然变得“反常”，平静的搜查官生活之下涌动起了危险的暗流。
她永远也无法预料到，为欧泊清除了无数威胁的自己，终有一日也会成为欧泊眼中的“威胁”。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
Since she joined the Sentinel Bureau, Lawine was always first in the office and last to leave. Her mission performance was no different - a record of excellence. The Bureau gave her a sense of purpose, and Lawine felt it was only right that she give her all in return.
“Justice, Bravery, Perseverance! We fight to protect this beautiful utopia!” The investigator's vow drove Lawine. It became the reason she drew her blade.
As the toll of each mission built up, Lawine's trusty practice sword became damaged beyond repair. The damage did not go unnoticed. It wasn't long before her chatterbox of a partner presented her with a new blade.
“To celebrate the first anniversary of Investigator Lawine's appointment...”
“And check it out... I've got one too! It's a set!
Lawine didn't really care. She was more concerned with when the next mission would start. That said... She couldn't bring herself to refuse her partner's warm invitation. On their next rest day, the two met again under Komos Tower to watch the sunset.
Lawine thought that those days would last forever...
But at some point, that chatterbox started acting “strangely,” and an undercurrent of danger returned to the investigator's peaceful life.
She would never have imagined that, despite having eliminated countless threats in PUS' name, she would one day receive the same mark.

StoryContent.SourceString:
为了进一步调查搭档的“反常举动”，拉薇似乎无意间触碰了绝不可知的“禁忌”。
她沿着蛛丝马迹深入探索，中途得到了上司梅瑞狄斯的协助。梅瑞狄斯对欧泊的怀疑由来已久。二人在调查中了解到了光明之下欧泊的幽暗。
尽管难以置信，但欧泊的秘密计划已经触及了拉薇的底线，违背了她为欧泊执刀的初心。
拉薇与梅瑞狄斯协商后，她们决定将全部真相公之于众。另一方面，欧泊官方也察觉到了她们的举动，派遣特务部队执行暗杀。
在一次追击中，拉薇和搭档再度相遇，但此次重逢却是兵戈相见。
不知为何，搭档毫不迟疑地向她扣下扳机。一声枪响，无情的子弹击碎了那柄匕首，连同她们之间亲密无间的温暖时光。
拉薇已无法在欧泊境内安身，她被官方登记为“叛逃”，在梅瑞狄斯的帮助下她接触到了一个名为“剪刀手”的组织。
加入剪刀手后，她隐去了原本的名字，融入夜色，遁影藏踪，身居前线与欧泊对抗。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
As she investigated the "strange behavior" of her partner, Lawine inadvertently touched upon a secret taboo.
Lawine dove deeper into the mystery, assisted along the way by her boss, Meredith, who herself had long-held suspicions about the organization. As they peeled the layers of the onion, they eventually learned about P.U.S' dark nature.
The truth was hard to believe. But it had crossed a line. Lawine knew that she would no longer be able to draw her blade for P.U.S.
Lawine and Meredith concluded that the public had to know the truth, but P.U.S executives had grown wise to what was going on. A group of assassins was already heading their way.
Amid her escape, Lawine came face-to-face with her partner once more - this time as enemies.
To Lawine's surprise, her partner showed no hesitation. A gunshot sounded, and as a cold bullet shattered Lawine's blade, the warm thread of their friendship was abruptly severed.
Officially branded as a defector, Lawine moved to the edges of society. With Meredith's help, she came into contact with an organization known as The Scissors.
Casting away her original name, she blended into the night. She resolved to bring the fight to P.U.S. Lawine would disappear, but a new face on the front lines would take her place.

StoryContent.SourceString:
剪刀手的成员因对旧家园的怀念与共同的文化信仰而凝聚一心。拉薇在这里寻回了故乡的宁静，也找到了新的战斗理由——现在，她这柄刀为斩断虚妄而生。
在拉薇身上，从欧泊到剪刀手从未改变过就是对组织命令的执行力。“组织是第一位的”，这样的思想已然深植她的脑海。
只有与拉薇非常亲近的战友才能瞥见，在那一袭鲜红的作战服下，隐藏了诸多深浅不一的伤口，记录了她的每一场战斗。
拉薇已经习惯了与伤痛作伴，受伤后从来都是简单包扎就再度投入战斗。可以确定的是，在拉薇的作战报告中，与她搭档的队友很少有负伤记录，准确来说，她会主动替队友挡下大多数攻击。
“什么时候你也关心关心自己啊！”经常与她作战的明抱怨道。
再锋利的刃也会在时光中磨损迟钝。在无数个孤独的长夜，旧搭档的身影在眼前挥之不去，拉薇的心在战斗中变得迷茫起来。
她记得母亲生前常说，种种花草能使心灵平静，当兰草长成、花开枝头时，说不定会有新的际遇。
拉薇找熟人要来了一袋兰草的种子，在自己的住所种下，暗暗期待着奇迹的发生。
或许因为生长条件苛刻，兰草迟迟不开花，这令拉薇苦恼不已。
但是，自从遇到那个人以后，沉眠的兰草却突然鼓起了花苞……
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
The Scissors are united by a common love for their old home and shared beliefs. Here, Lawine found the tranquility of her old home and a new reason to fight. She now raised her blade for a new purpose - to cut through falsehoods.
But that didn't mean that everything had changed. Lawine was still as excellent a soldier as ever, following orders to a tee. “Orders come first” became her motto.
Only those who grew exceptionally close to Lawine would be able to catch a glimpse at the myriad wounds under her bright red armor - each telling the tale of a different battle.
Lawine had long gotten used to the pain. Every wound was the same. Just patch it up and return to the fight. Her teammates fared much better. In fact, Lawine had a habit of putting herself between them and harm's way.
“When are you going to take care of yourself for a change?!” Ming was growing worried.
Even the sharpest blade dulls with time. In countless long and lonely nights, the image of Lawine's old partner lingered in her mind, confusing her heart in battle.
She remembered the words of her mother, who said that nature calms the mind. As orchids grow and flowers bloom, they symbolize new opportunities.
Lawine asked an acquaintance for a bag of orchid seeds and planted them in her home, holding the secret hope for a miracle.
The orchids did not grow. The troubled Lawine figured that the conditions were probably just too harsh.
But, ever since she met that person, the seeds suddenly began to sprout...

StoryContent.SourceString:
从有记忆的年岁开始，心夏就习惯了一个人的家。
心夏的父母当然并不希望自己的女儿经历这样一个寂寞的童年，但是，在人类向卡丘世界展开大移民之前的那几年，这两位知名的学者不得不奔波辗转于世界各地，记录和保存人类珍贵的文化遗产。这是他们为之献身的事业。
年幼的心夏还无法理解父母所肩负的重大使命，甚至无法理解“孤独”和“寂寞”——不，她并不感到孤独。
即使是在小小的家中，也有数不尽的新鲜事物等待着她的探索。
第一次自己穿衣服，第一次自己洗澡，第一次自己做早餐，还有……第一次把高压锅炸飞。
每一个第一次都让心夏雀跃不已。
她就像一个天生的探险家，用纯真的好奇心独自揭开着世界的神秘面纱。
可是……她唯独没法给自己讲睡前故事。因为讲故事的人自己可不能睡着。
想到这一点时，年幼的心夏也许是第一次感到了孤独。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
For as long as she can remember, Kokona had always been all by herself.
It was never her parents' intention for her to experience such a lonely childhood, but in the years before the great migration to Strinova, the two renowned scholars were needed in every reach of Earth to preserve a record of humanity's cultural heritage. It was a cause to which they dedicated their lives.
The young Kokona did not understand the great undertaking shouldered by her parents, nor did she understand the concepts of “solitude” or “loneliness” - no, it would be more accurate to say that she simply did not feel lonely.
Even in her small home, there was always something new to explore.
The first time she dressed herself, the first time she took a bath, the first time she made breakfast, and, of course, the first time she blew up the pressure cooker...
Each and every one of these firsts opened a whole new world to Kokona.
A born explorer, she faced every mystery in her world with a heart of pure curiosity.
But... She could never tell herself a bedtime story. The person who told the story wasn't supposed to fall asleep.
When she thought of this, the young Kokona felt a hint of loneliness for the first time.

StoryTitle.LocalizedString: The Story of Mister Sea Bunny

StoryContent.SourceString:
“心夏，生日快乐！这次的礼物有些不一样，我们不在的时候，可以让它给你讲故事。爱你的爸爸妈妈。”
每年生日，心夏都会收到父母从远方寄来的信件和礼物。礼物的内容五花八门，奇怪的人偶、精巧的织品……每次心夏拆开礼物之前都会猜测一番，再在下一次视频通话时大加点评，这是他们一家特有的亲子互动。
但是这一次的礼物，实在超出心夏的预料——那是一个圆滚滚的桶型智能家政机器人。
在见惯了各种稀奇古怪的古董、文玩之后，这是心夏与现代前沿科技产品的第一次碰撞。
简洁的外形、坚固的新型材料……当然还有神奇的人工智能，这些现代工艺美学的结晶让心夏感受到了一种完全不同的美。
按下开机键，机器人头顶的感应器就滴溜溜地转了起来，就像两只兔子耳朵。
“机器人先生……请问你是兔子吗？你怎么会有一对兔子耳朵？”
“纠正，本机的‘触角’是模仿海兔设计的生物工学感应器。”
“所以……不是兔子？是海兔先生吗？”
“指令不明。请求确认，您是否想要将‘海兔先生’登记为本机的用户昵称。”
“我听不懂……海兔先生，你能给我讲讲你自己的故事吗？”
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
“Happy birthday, Kokona! This gift is a little different than usual. It'll be able to tell you stories while we're away. Love, mom and dad.”
Kokona always received a letter and gift from her far-away parents for her birthday. The contents would vary greatly from year to year, from strange dolls to exquisite fabrics... Every time Kokona was about to open a gift, she would make a guess and comment on what she received during the next video call. It was the special little ritual of her family.
Kokona would have never been able to guess what she received this time - a round, barrel-shaped housekeeping bot.
Though she'd seen all manner of strange antiques and artifacts, this was the first time Kokona had come into contact with such advanced technology.
Boasting a simple design, powerful, cutting-edge materials, and the power of AI, these bots gave Kokona an entirely new sense of wonder.
When she pressed the power button, the sensor on the top of the bot would spin around like a pair of rabbit ears.
“Mister Robot, are you a rabbit? What's up with the pair of long ears?”
“Correction. The 'antennas' on this device are biosensors designed to imitate those on sea bunnies.”
“So... You're not a rabbit? Should I call you Mister Sea Bunny?”
“Unknown command. Owner may be attempting to register 'Mister Sea Bunny' as the username of this machine. Please confirm.”
“I don't get it... Mister Sea Bunny, won't you please tell me your story?”

StoryContent.SourceString:
“后来我才知道，海兔先生长得一点也不像海兔！它的身子并不柔软，进了水还会短路……”
“请等一下，心夏同学。”面试官打断了心夏关于海兔先生的长篇大论。
“我们已经知道你很喜欢这个……家政机器人了。我们也很欣赏你对机器人工学的兴趣，但仅仅如此是没法通过本校的招生面试的。”
“别急别急，我还没说完呢！那之后啊——海兔先生就被我拆成了一堆零件！”
“你是说，在那个还需要听故事的年纪？很有意思，但还不够。”
“那么，如果我说我把拆出来的零件重新组装成了一个小型无人机呢？瞧，就是这个！你看，是不是更像一只小海兔了？”
“嗯，以学生的水平而言，完成的还不错……但，有一个致命的问题。”
看着茫然无措的心夏，面试官叹了口气。
“听好了，现在的它只是一个图有外表的空壳。心夏，机器也该有自己的灵魂。”
心夏有些沮丧，她从来没考虑过这个问题。
正如面试官所说，如今的海兔无人机只是一个造型精巧的玩具罢了。
看来这次申请要以失败告终了。
……
“为它找到自己的灵魂，这就是你接下来的课题。”
“咦？教授，您是说……”
“没错，你合格了。欢迎加入莱特工学院。还有，叫我导师。”
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
“I only found out later that Mister Sea Bunny looks nothing like his namesake at all! His body isn't soft and gooey at all! He even short-circuits when I put him in water...”
“Please wait a moment, Kokona.” The admissions officer tried collecting themselves from the girl's long-winded rant.
“We already know that you have great affection for this... housekeeping bot. We do appreciate your interest in robotics, but I feel obliged to say that we won't be able to admit you based on just that.”
“Don't worry! Don't worry! There's more to my story. After that, I dismantled Mister Sea Bunny down to his core components!”
“You're saying you managed to disassemble a robot at such a young age? Impressive, but I'll need to hear more.”
“What if I told you I put him back together? Check it out! Doesn't he look more like a sea bunny now?”
“Hm. Not bad for a student. But there's a fatal flaw.”
Faced with Kokona's blank expression, the admissions officer let out a sigh.
“Listen carefully. What you have now is just an empty shell with a cute face. Kokona, machines should also have their own souls.”
Kokona let out a slight frown of dejection. She had never thought about this.
The admissions officer was right. She had turned Mister Sea Bunny into nothing more than a sophisticated toy.
She wasn't looking forward to telling her parents about this rejection...
...
“Your first piece of homework will be finding him a soul.”
“Eh? So you're saying...”
“That's right. You've been admitted. Welcome to the Wright Institute of Technology. One more thing - It's 'teacher' from now on.”

StoryTitle.LocalizedString: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?

StoryContent.SourceString:
“为无人机找到自己的灵魂”。
导师的一句话，让心夏陷入了漫长的思索。
心夏对于机器人工学的兴趣完全源自于她对新鲜事物的好奇心，从来没有想过自己设计和制作的道具要用于什么样的目的。心夏决定要找到一个最适合它的工作。
轻巧的身体让它能飞上天空，拥有广阔的视野，小巧的体型让它可以穿过缝隙，在复杂的地形中穿行……综合这些优点所得出的结论是——
“啊啊——还是想不出来！”，苦恼的心夏挠着头在校园里踱步。
这时一位比心夏年纪稍小的少女走了过来：“请问，你有什么烦恼吗？”。
或许只是为了排解忧郁，虽然并不抱什么希望，心夏还是向少女再一次讲述了关于导师的课题，以及海兔先生的前世今生。
“既然这样，为什么不问问它自己呢？如果是海兔先生，它会想为人类做些什么呢？”
说完这句话的少女，很快被不远处一位看似欧泊高管的女性叫走了。
留在心夏记忆中的，只有绘在少女衣裙上的那片灿烂星空，以及这句无心之语。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
“Your first piece of homework will be finding him a soul.”
Her teacher's words sent Kokona into a deep period of contemplation.
Kokona's interest in robotics stemmed entirely from her unceasing curiosity about the new. But she had never given much thought to the purpose of her designs. Kokona resolved to find a task befitting of Mister Sea Bunny.
His light frame provided excellent aerodynamics. He had a wide field of vision. His small size meant he could squeeze through gaps and navigate difficult terrain. The most suitable task would be...
“Arrrrgh! I've got nothing!!” Kokona scratched her head in distress as she paced through campus.
Attention drawn by the ruckus, a girl slightly younger than Kokona popped her head around the corner. “Excuse me - is there something bothering you?”
Perhaps she just needed someone to vent to. Kokona wasn't expecting much. Nevertheless, she painstakingly repeated the story of her assignment and Mister Sea Bunny's past and present life.
“If that's the case, why don't you just ask him? If he could choose, what would Mister Sea Bunny like to do?”
Before she could say anything else, the girl was quickly called away by an older woman bearing the uniform of a PUS executive.
Kokona can still clearly recall the brilliant starry pattern on that girl's dress, along with her carefree advice.

StoryContent.SourceString:
在距离毕业答辩只剩不到一个月的时候，心夏终于完成了对无人机进行医疗用途改造的设计图。
为了这一天，心夏花费了很长的时间，从零开始学习医学知识，甚至取得了医师资格证。
在社团好友们的帮助下，心夏的海兔无人机终于在毕业答辩的前一天完成了改造和调试。
来不及准备讲稿的心夏磕磕绊绊地完成了答辩，怀着忐忑的心情等待着导师的判决。
结果，心夏的毕业答辩，取得了当年的最高分。
“你做的很好，心夏。不过，你真的不打算接受我的邀请，留下来当我的助教吗？”
面对导师的邀请，心夏郑重地予以了感谢和拒绝。
“我决定了，我会和这孩子一起努力，把它的力量带给最需要的人。”
————
青春的回忆总是让人怀念。时至今日，心夏想起这些过去时也会会心一笑。
“心夏前辈，这么开心，有什么好事啊？”
“想知道吗？走，下班之后陪我吃烤串去！”
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
With less than a month left before she had to defend her dissertation, Kokona finally drew up the design draft to transform Mister Sea Bunny into a medbot.
To get to this point, Kokona had gone through the trouble of learning medicine from scratch and even earned a medical certificate.
With the help of the school robotics club, Kokona modified and debugged Mister Sea Bunny just in time for her defense.
With no time to prepare any kind of speech, the girl stumbled through her defense and waited anxiously for the teacher's verdict.
The result? She had the highest score in her entire cohort.
“You've done amazingly, Kokona. But are you really not going to stay on as my teaching assistant?”
Kokona expressed her thanks but was firm in her choice.
“I've made my decision. I'm going to work hard with this child and bring his abilities to those who need them most.”
————
The memories of youth always make one wistful. Kokona was no different. Recalling those days, she always smiles with a knowing expression.
“Kokona! What's got you so happy?”
“Wanna hear the story? Once we're done with work, I'll tell you over some barbeque skewers.”

StoryContent.SourceString:
在玛德蕾娜·利里7岁生日的那天，身为艺术家的父母为她订制了一块调色盘。
这是她生平收到的第一份生日礼物，小玛德蕾娜给它起名为“七彩”，幻想着能在里面填上无穷无尽的色彩。
她用“七彩”创作了一幅画作。平日严肃的父母望着那幅画，罕见地面露幸福的神情——玛德蕾娜很喜欢那样的表情。
她决定，往后一定要加倍努力地练习绘画，她想更多地带给别人快乐。
按照利里夫妇的安排，小玛德蕾娜和姐姐加拉蒂亚每天都要进行大量的练习，从早上6点一直持续到晚上9点。
那块调色盘渐渐地从白白净净变成五颜六色的，而她的脸蛋或者手心上也经常沾上颜料，像一只脏兮兮的大花猫。
与之相反，她的姐姐很不满于这种既定的生活，白天要么玩消失，要么带回蠕动着的奇怪“素材”；然后夜里姐姐的身影再如同鬼魅般突然浮现。这一系列行为带给了同一屋檐下的玛德蕾娜诸多心惊肉跳的回忆。
即使如此，玛德蕾娜还是主动帮忙给姐姐打圆场，躲避父母的盘问。
因而，她也养成了乐于助人的好习惯，外出取材时顺手搞定邻居们的委托，使她在街坊领里之间收获了很高的评价。
带给别人快乐，似乎成为这个天真小姑娘的幸福感来源。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
On Maddelena Leary's seventh birthday, her parents, both artists themselves, presented her with a custom palette.
It was the first birthday gift she had received in her life. Young Maddelena named the palette “Kaleidoscope,” dreaming of all the colors she could fill it with.
When she painted with Kaleidoscope, the typically serious expression on her parents' faces was washed away by a look of rare happiness - it was one that the girl cherished greatly.
Maddelena resolved that she would dedicate herself to art. She wanted to create that same expression in others.
The Learys were a stern couple. Maddelena and her sister Galatea were required to spend every day in grueling practice, from six in the morning to nine at night.
As her palette grew more and more colorful, Maddelena's face and palms often became stained with paint, and the girl started to resemble a shabby cat.
Unlike Maddelena, her sister grew dissatisfied with their planned-out lives. During the day, Galatea would either be missing or returning home with strange, wriggling “materials,” while at night, she would suddenly appear out of nowhere like a ghost. These antics delivered no shortage of frights to poor Maddelena.
Nevertheless, Maddelena covered for her sister when she could, protecting Galatea from their parents' questioning.
In this way, Maddelena developed a habit of being helpful to those around her. Whenever she was out collecting materials for her art, she would always try to help those she encountered. It wasn't long before she had earned high esteem among her neighbors.
For this innocent girl, it seemed that making others happy was enough.

StoryContent.SourceString:
明星院校“伊莱特隆艺术学院”培育了无数艺界英才，入读这所院校也是利里夫妇对姐妹二人的最大期望。
看到姐姐以保送免试的形式轻松入学，玛德蕾娜心里暗下决心，一定要考上那所学校！
之后她参加了号称“炼狱级难度”但通过率在报考生中极有信服力的封闭式集训。
往后回忆起那段时光，她只记得她累到差点把颜料当早饭下咽，做梦都在刻画光影、塑造形体。
所幸最终她以齐平录取分数的成绩勉强考入了那所学校。
在父母送别她的那天，她却觉得心里空落落的，这是她第一次离家这么远修习艺术。
特别地，她带上了那块调色盘同自己一起远行。
往后全新而陌生的学校生活令玛德蕾娜产生诸多了不适。
素描课上交了油画课的作业，穿着雕塑课的衣服来上游泳课，诸如此类的迷糊事情时有发生。
“天才加拉蒂亚的妹妹居然是个迷糊鬼”——这种印象与人们的预期严重不符。
玛德蕾娜的部分迷糊事迹，不经意间成为学生们的趣谈，她以“某某的迷糊妹妹”的名号在学生间出名。
每当结束快节奏而混乱的一天后，疲惫的玛德蕾娜就会躲在宿舍里，望着陌生的天花板，久久地发呆。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
The Elitron School of Arts, known colloquially as ESA, had a sterling reputation for creating stars out of its students. Having the sisters make it into the school had been the Learys' greatest ambition.
When Galatea got into ESA without even sitting the exam based on a recommendation, Maddelena resolved that she wouldn't lose out to her sister.
Looking to improve her chances, Maddelena signed up for a training camp known in equal part for its grueling difficulty and prestige amongst admissions officers.
Thinking back on those days, Maddelena can only recall that she was so tired that she nearly drank a cup of paint for breakfast. Her dreams were filled with dancing lights and shapes taking form.
But at least her hard work paid off. She was able to get into ESA with the same admission scores.
On the day she bid farewell to her parents, Maddelena felt an emptiness inside. It was her first time studying so far away from home.
She made a special point of taking her cherished palette along with her.
Maddelena's new and unfamiliar school life was a source of much discomfort.
She became frazzled - her semesters filled with embarrassing mistakes like handing in her oil painting homework during sketching class and arriving at swimming class in her sculpting class uniform.
“How could a genius like Galatea be the sister of such a klutz?” Maddelena was nothing like what people expected.
As tales of her mishaps spread across the school, she earned herself a new reputation among the students - “that girl's klutzy sister.”
After each fast-paced and chaotic day, Maddelena would always hide away in her dorm, staring at an unfamiliar ceiling, lost in a trance.

StoryContent.SourceString:
绰号也好，流言也罢，玛德蕾娜对学校里的一切习惯性地一笑置之。
她将更多的精力投入到学业中，艰难地保持着中等偏上的成绩。
临近毕业设计之时，她提出的多个方案被导师否决，于是她向早已毕业的姐姐加拉蒂亚寻求帮助。
玛德蕾娜给姐姐展示了自己精心设计的三十多张草图，她期望着姐姐能够理解与欣赏她的设计。
但是姐姐的反应却稀松平常，淡淡地说了一句——
“你的设计根本算不上是艺术。”
姐姐说话向来单刀直入，但这句无心之言还是刺痛了玛德蕾娜。
玛德蕾娜当即要求姐姐展示她的设计，对着那些潦草随性、意味不明的线条圆圈（甚至当中有的是空白图案），玛德蕾娜的心里写满了问号。
“你的意思是……这些就算是艺术咯？”
“不然呢？是你那些无人关注的草稿吗？你知道拍卖行给我的估值是多少个理想币吗？”
“姐姐，艺术是不能完全用金钱来衡量的……”
“你的想法还真是稚嫩，所以至今为止你还像雏鸟一样蜷缩在被安排好的鸟窝里，连艺术的门槛都够不到！”
氛围紧张到了前所未有的程度，姐妹二人的争吵吸引了利里夫妇的介入。
这场争吵最终是如何收尾的，玛德蕾娜早已不记得。
她和姐姐还保持着从前的和睦，姐姐会给她分享好看的帽子，她会吐槽姐姐古怪的设计。
然而，从那次争吵之后，玛德蕾娜发现，姐姐在家的时间少了很多，经常神秘消失或失联。
她不知道姐姐去了哪里，她只是隐隐察觉，有一道无形的壁垒堵在了姐姐和她，和这个家之间。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
Maddelena developed a habit of laughing off everything at school, no matter the nicknames or gossip.
Redoubling her efforts in her studies, she was able to barely maintain above-average grades.
As Maddelena's graduation project neared, many of her proposals were rejected by her instructors. Seeking help, she sought out Galatea, who had already graduated.
Maddelena showed Galatea sister over thirty carefully designed sketches with the genuine hope that her sister would be able to understand and appreciate her designs.
But all she got was a cold response,
“These designs shouldn't count as art at all.”
Galatea was always straight to the point. Her words weren't intended to sting, but how could they not?
Maddelena immediately asked if she could see Galatea's designs. When she was given a bunch of scraggly lines and circles with no clear meaning (some sketches were even blank!), she only grew more confused.
“Do you mean... that these count as art?”
“Then what should? Those sketches of yours that no one gives a second look? Do you have any idea how many Dream Tokens the auction house has valued these at?”
“Sister, art can't be measured in Dream Tokens...”
“You're still as naive as ever. You've stayed curled up in your cage like a bird without wings - that's why no one's opening their doors to you!”
The atmosphere grew tense enough to cut with a knife. The sisters continued to bicker until their parents finally intervened.
Maddelena has long forgotten how their fight ended.
She and Galatea returned to their old equilibrium. Galatea would show her beautiful hats while she would express exasperation at Galatea's strange designs.
But ever since that fight, Maddelena found that her sister spent far less time at home. Galatea would often disappear or drop out of contact without so much as a warning.
She had no idea where Galatea would go, but she could tell something had changed. An invisible barrier was standing between Maddelena, Galatea, and their family.

StoryContent.SourceString:
毕业后的数年内，玛德蕾娜忙于在各艺术馆、杂志社之间奔走，她寄希望于通过投稿的形式让自己的艺术获得外界的关注。
而同一时期，她的姐姐，加拉蒂亚·利里，已经登上了乌尔比诺最知名的艺术鉴赏节目《达·芬奇之手》，在闪烁的聚光灯下，展现着迷人的身姿以及她犀利的观点。
不爱观看这类节目的玛德蕾娜，也从身边人的嘴里得知了姐姐声名远扬的事情。
尽管她从未停止奔跑的步伐，但是她得到的反响却相对平淡。在姐姐也参与的设计比赛中，她也无一例外地都输给了姐姐。
风曳镇即兴创作比赛、伊莱特隆艺术学院校友赛……这些败北，几乎多得数不过来。
“你像雏鸟一样蜷缩在鸟窝里”、“你连艺术的门槛都够不到”……
姐姐这些聒噪的话语如同回响一样萦绕在玛德蕾娜的耳畔。
玛德蕾娜觉得在姐姐的光芒之下，自己黯淡得就像发不出光的星星。
沮丧与迷茫如同一粒粒沙子在她的内心积压，父母问候的电话她开始不知道如何回应，渐渐地她不敢再回到熟悉的家中。
在没有告知父母的情况下，玛德蕾娜悄悄地决定成为一名自由职业画师，继续在艺术的浪潮中漂流，在山野，森林，溪流边捕捉灵感。
她带着“设计师不是在创作，就是在取材的路上”这样的理念四处奔走。
据说在卡丘世界的各个角落都能看到她的身影。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
Following her graduation, Maddelena busied herself with submitting her art to museums and magazines, hoping to expand her reach.
As Maddelena labored away, Galatea's star continued to rise - even appearing on Urbino's most popular art program, The Hand of Leonardo, making a name for herself with her charming demeanor and sharp opinions.
Maddelena never liked those kinds of programs. Still, she heard much about her sister from those around her.
Even though Maddelena continued to work hard, the responses she received were muted. Whenever she and Galatea submitted designs to the same competition, she would always lose.
The Windy Town Improvisation Competition, the ESA Alumni Competition, and so many more... Her defeats were too numerous to count.
“You've stayed curled up in your cage like a bird without wings - that's why no one's opening their doors to you!”
Her sister's shouts lingered in Maddelena's ears like a distant echo.
The brighter Galatea shined, the more Maddelena felt her light dimmed.
As grains of frustration and confusion filled her heart, she lost the will to return her parent's calls. Eventually, she didn't even dare to return home.
Without telling her parents, Maddelena set out as a freelance artist, drifting along the art world and taking inspiration from nature.
She developed a motto to guide her journey, “designers are either in the process of creation or the process of inspiration.”
It's said that traces of her can be found in every corner of Strinova.

StoryContent.SourceString:
玛德蕾娜的艺术长河并非一直毫无波澜，她的“灵光一现”偶尔也能激起几朵水花——
只是它们无一例外地都是玛德蕾娜因祸得福或助人为乐时的即兴创作。
诸如，用打碎的玻璃拼装成的《莎丽娜蒙》装饰画，帮邻居家剪的“比萨斜塔”窗花。
这些设计有的在玛德蕾娜的邻居间掀起一股预订热潮，有的还入选了艺术馆创意设计区的特别珍藏。
凭借着偶得的好运气，她揽下了不少订单，基本能够保障自己自由画师的生活。
同时她也享受着，在充满麻烦的日常里，通过帮助别人带来的小小乐趣。
但是，家里一通通催促的电话紧接而来，她抵不过一连串问询，在父母的建议之下，到白芸艺术馆接手了一份初级画师的工作。
（顺带一提，这家艺术馆似乎是乌尔比诺某个白姓大人物的私人资产。）
每天的工作均是一些基础而繁琐的事务，以她的能力应对绰绰有余。
出于工作的关系，玛德蕾娜经常接触到一些艺术鉴赏相关的资讯或节目，聚光灯下姐姐的光辉又再度映入眼帘。
“如果我也能身披那样的光芒……”
怀揣着小小的不甘，玛德蕾娜再次看向了那块污迹斑斑的“七彩”调色盘，假想着里面填满了属于自己的色彩……
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
Though Maddelena's career was rocky, her eureka moments still made the occasional splash.
The problem - they're all sparks of improvisation, usually from when Maddelena gets a blessing in disguise or when she's helping someone else.
"Lisa Mona" was created with broken glass, while "Leaning Tower of Pisa" came from helping a neighbor cut their window grills.
Some of Maddelena's inspired designs led to a rush of bookings from her neighbors, while others were even showcased in the creative works areas of local museums.
With the help of some luck, Maddelena was able to secure a string of orders - enough to keep her comfortable as a freelancer.
All the while, she continued to enjoy the small pleasures of helping out those around her.
But the calls from home did not stop, and she eventually had to give in. At the urging of her parents, Maddelena took a job as a painter at Cloudscape Gallery.
Rumors had it that the museum was owned by a Urbino bigshot - someone who went by the name of Bai.
The work was basic and tedious. Cloudscape Gallery was hardly a challenge for her skills.
As a result of her post, Maddelena was once again exposed to the media of the art world and, inevitably, her sister's continued stardom.
"If only I could shine so brightly..."
With a hint of defiance, Maddelena looked down on Kaleidoscope palette, imagining it was filled with her own vivid colors...

StoryTitle.LocalizedString: The Phantom Bear and the Shut-In

StoryContent.SourceString:
在卡丘世界的技术宅群体中，流传着一个神秘传说——午夜徘徊的幽灵熊。
据说，如果选择午夜时分在社区内发布需求，有很大概率被一个头像是“熊”的匿名客接取。匿名熊报价低、效率高、成果好，除了话少外，就挑不出什么毛病了。不少委托者想把这位民间大神招入麾下，可无论他们开出多高的报价，匿名熊每次都直接拒绝，回复从不超过五个字。慢慢的，它因为孤僻独行，被其他人称为“午夜徘徊的幽灵熊”。
而在卡丘世界的某小区内，也流传着一个神秘传说——X栋X0X的住户是一个从不出门的死宅，几年来都没有人亲眼见过TA，连外卖都是靠一只凶巴巴的机器熊代取的。
“……这人真奇怪，该不会跟那只熊一样，样子太过凶狠，所以不敢以真面目示人吧？”
虽然已经尽可能快地把门关上，邻居的议论声还是飘了进来。菲用毛绒绒的身体挡住了门缝，似乎想把那些伤人话语挡在门外。伊薇特接过菲递过来的便当外卖，踮起脚尖，摸了摸菲的头。
“菲，不凶狠。”
“伊薇特……也不奇怪。”
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
In the tech-enthusiast circles of Strinova, there's an urban legend about a mysterious bear that roams at midnight. They say if you post a request in the community at midnight, there's a high chance it will be accepted by an anonymous user with a "bear" avatar. This anonymous bear offers low prices, works efficiently, and delivers outstanding results. Apart from being rather quiet, there's hardly any flaw. Many have tried to recruit this folk legend with generous offers, but no matter how high the bid, the anonymous bear always rejects them with replies never exceeding five words. Over time, due to its solitary nature, it's been dubbed the "Phantom Bear of Midnight."

There's another legend in a certain neighborhood of Strinova—nobody's ever seen the resident of Building X, Unit X0X, in years. They never leave home and even have a grumpy robot bear to pick up deliveries for them.
"…What a strange person. Maybe they're too intimidating, like that bear, and don’t dare show their face to others?"
Despite trying to shut the door quickly, the neighbors' chatter still seeped through. Fay pressed its fluffy body against the crack, as if trying to shield Yvette from the hurtful comments. Yvette took the delivery from Fay, stood on her toes, and gently patted Fay's head.
"Fay, not scary."
"Yvette… not strange either."

StoryContent.SourceString:
“午夜徘徊的幽灵熊”和“深居简出的死宅”，真实身份是同一个——身边陪伴着机器熊的少女伊薇特。
伊薇特的童年在研究所里度过。身为高级研究员的父母工作忙碌，无暇照顾她，便把她安置在实验室的角落，丢两本书给她打发时间。看似孤独，伊薇特却很享受这种生活：安静，没有人打扰，她可以全身心投入到那些艰涩的研究中，幻想着自己长大后，也能成为在数据台前操作的人。
她原本以为，这样平静的生活会一直持续下去，直到那一天，她醒来后发现家里安静得有些诡异。没有说话声，没有脚步声，没有呼吸声……
伊薇特从不觉得自己是一个直觉性很强的人，但她固执地认为，彼时冲上心头的笃定预感才是她和父母间亲子关系的最有力证明。她不用等待，也不用向谁求证，只要看到书架上一并消失的研究手册，就能确认这个事实——父母离开了，没有带上她。
伊薇特从小就不怕冷。无论是为了保证设备稳定而常年低温的研究所，还是总飘着漫天大雪的故乡，她只觉得这个温度很舒服。
而父母离开的那天，是伊薇特度过最冷的一天。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
The "Phantom Bear" and the "Tech Hermit" are actually the same person—a girl named Yvette, always accompanied by her robot bear.
Yvette spent her childhood in a research facility. With her parents being busy senior researchers, there was little time for her. They left her in the lab's corner with a couple of books to pass the time. Despite the solitude, Yvette enjoyed this life: it was quiet and undisturbed, allowing her to dive deep into complex studies, dreaming of one day becoming one of those experts working at the data terminal.
She assumed this peaceful routine would continue forever until one morning when she woke to an unsettling silence at home. No voices, no footsteps, no breathing...
Yvette never considered herself particularly intuitive, but she stubbornly believed that the overwhelming certainty she felt at that moment was the strongest proof of her bond with her parents. She didn’t need to wait or ask anyone to confirm it; she only had to notice the vanished research manuals from the bookshelf to realize the truth—her parents had left, without her.
Yvette had never minded the cold. Whether it was the perpetually chilled research lab that ensured equipment stability or her snow-laden hometown, she found the temperature comfortable.
But the day her parents left was the coldest day Yvette ever endured.

StoryContent.SourceString:
“最后问一次……你真的不和我们走吗？”戴眼镜的中年女人站在门口，犹疑不知是否该离开。
戴兜帽的小女孩摇了摇头，宽大的帽檐滑落了一些，遮住了她的眼睛。
“伊薇特……可以自己生活。对，还、还有菲，菲也是家人……”
女人叹息一声，最后还是转过了身。

伊薇特抱着玩具熊坐在沙发上，访客离去后，她的世界又安静了下来。她无意识地摸着菲的耳朵，脑海开始放空：菲是从没有送过自己礼物的妈妈，第一次送给自己的礼物。在把菲交到她手上时，妈妈在想什么呢？她的心情，会是歉疚，无奈，还是像终于能够丢弃累赘般如释重负……
伊薇特的手一顿，她在菲的耳朵上摸到了奇怪的东西——
开线了……
菲耳朵和身体连接的地方，不知道什么时候出现了一个裂缝，就像菲也受伤了一样。

眼前瞬间模糊起来，眼泪啪嗒啪嗒掉落，似乎也想用自己来缝合玩具熊的伤口。
“没关系的，菲……”伊薇特用手背抹去眼泪：“伊薇特，会治好菲，给菲安上不会受伤的身体……”
“菲，不要再离开伊薇特了……”
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
"Let me ask one last time... are you sure you won't come with us?" A middle-aged woman with glasses stood hesitantly at the door, unsure whether to leave.
The hooded girl shook her head, her oversized hood slipping down to cover her eyes.
"Yvette... can manage on her own. Yes, and there's Fay, too. Fay is family..."
With a sigh, the woman finally turned away.
Yvette sat on the sofa holding her teddy bear, and once the visitor left, her world returned to silence. Absentmindedly stroking Fay's ear, her mind began to wander: Fay was the first gift from her mother, who never gave her anything. What was her mother thinking when she handed Fay to her? Was she feeling guilty, helpless, or perhaps relieved to finally let go of a burden?
Her hand paused as she felt something odd on Fay's ear—a seam had come undone...
A small tear had formed where Fay's ear attached to its body, as if Fay was hurt too.
Her vision blurred with tears that fell in drops, as if hoping to mend the toy bear's wound.
"It's okay, Fay..." Yvette said, wiping her tears with the back of her hand. "Yvette will fix you, give you a body that won't get hurt..."
"Fay, please don't leave Yvette again..."

StoryContent.SourceString:
家人不辞而别，留给伊薇特用来伤感的时间也没那么多。她不得不面临一个很现实的问题：需要钱。
父母留下的钱，怎么计算，也只够她生活到成年，更别说想购买研究资料、升级电子设备——父母失踪后，再想去研究所也不太合适……
回想起之前登门拜访之人怜悯的眼神，伊薇特叹了口气。与其被置入这样复杂的社会关系中，她宁愿自己去赚钱。
只是，打工之路，好像有点难走啊……

便利店老板：“伊薇特小姐，有顾客反馈说希望您平日里多笑笑，他的孩子都不敢过来结账了。”
——“好，我努力笑……”
猫咖老板：“伊薇特啊，虽然我们是猫咖，但也是女仆主题的猫咖，只和小动物呆在一起是不行的喔。”
——“啊？呜……招聘广告，没这么说的呀……”
项目负责人：“伊薇特，集体会议马上就要开始了，你这是要去哪？”
——“抱歉……！人太多了，先、先走一步！”
夜晚，在打工之路上处处碰壁的伊薇特坐在沙发上发愁：“怎么办呢，菲的材料只买齐了一半……还有一半的钱……”
黑暗的房间内，只有屏幕的显示灯一明一暗闪烁；而伊薇特突然像想起了什么一般，站起来快步跑到了电脑前。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
With her family gone without a word, Yvette didn't have much time to dwell on her sadness. She faced a pressing reality: she needed money.
No matter how she calculated, the money her parents left would only support her until adulthood, let alone buying research materials or upgrading electronic equipment. Going back to the research lab seemed inappropriate after her parents disappeared...
Thinking back to the visitor's pitying look, Yvette sighed. She'd rather earn money herself than rely on complicated social relationships.
However, the path to earning it seemed rather challenging...

Convenience Store Owner: "Miss Yvette, a customer mentioned they'd like to see you smile more. Their child is too scared to come to the checkout."
— "Alright, I'll try to smile..."
Cat Café Owner: "Yvette, even though we're a cat café, we're also a maid-themed café. Just hanging out with animals isn't enough."
— "Huh? Oh... That wasn't in the job ad..."
Project Leader: "Yvette, the team meeting is about to start. Where are you going?"
— "Sorry...! Too many people. I'll, uh, go ahead!"
At night, frustrated by her job search, Yvette sat on the sofa, worried. "What am I going to do? I’ve only bought half of Fay’s materials… still need the rest of the money..."
In the dark room, the computer screen flickered on and off. Suddenly, as if an idea struck her, Yvette sprang up and rushed to her computer.

StoryContent.SourceString:
“呃……咱没走错吧？”个子娇小的女孩打量着面前紧闭的门户：“这真是幽灵熊给你的地址？”
“不可能。这可是我和它做了这么多单生意累积起来的信任。今天，我一定要替欧泊拿下这员大将！”另一个长发女孩握紧了拳头给自己打气，随后敲响了门：“您好！请问————啊！！！”
门打开了一条窄缝，从里面探出一只目露凶光的熊头。两人吓了一跳，矮个子女孩下意识把长发女孩护在身后，而后者已经悄悄摸上了腰间的武器。
“那个……你们好，我是幽灵熊……”像变魔术一样，熊头后又探出一个圆圆的脑袋。戴着兜帽的少女小心翼翼地看向来人，声音越说越小，到最后几乎听不清了。

三人坐在沙发上，菲送上了两杯冰水。
星绘先开了口：“那我就开门见山了？我们代表欧泊官方，向伊薇特小姐发出邀请。欧泊很看重你数据溯源和追踪的能力，我们需要你的帮助……”
“需、需要我……？”伊薇特睁大了眼。
“需要呀！”心夏点点头：“你似乎很惊讶。可向你发出邀请的企业应该很多吧？”
“我，从不和他们私聊……”伊薇特迟疑地摇摇头。
来访者对视一眼，诧异于从未设想过的状况。
“原来如此。那我来详细说明一下……”

冰块慢慢融化，而命运的齿轮，也转动了起来。
StoryContent.LocalizedString:
"Uh... are we sure this is the right place?" The petite girl eyed the tightly shut door in front of them. "Is this really the address Phantom Bear gave you?"
"It can't be wrong. I've built trust with Phantom Bear through all our past dealings. Today, I'm determined to recruit this powerhouse for P.U.S!" The long-haired girl clenched her fist for encouragement, then knocked on the door. "Hello! Is this——ah!!!"
The door opened a crack, revealing a bear's head with a fierce gaze. Both girls jumped, and the shorter one instinctively shielded the long-haired girl, who discreetly reached for her weapon.
"Um... hi there, I'm Phantom Bear..." As if performing a magic trick, a round face emerged behind the bear. A hooded girl cautiously peeked out, her voice growing quieter until it was barely audible.

The three of them settled on the sofa as Fay served two glasses of iced water.
Celestia began, "Let me get straight to the point. We represent P.U.S and are here to invite Miss Yvette. P.U.S highly values your data tracing and tracking skills. We need your help..."
"Me? You need me...?" Yvette's eyes widened in surprise.
"Yes, we do!" Kokona nodded. "You seem surprised. Surely, many companies have reached out to you, right?"
"I never chat with them privately..." Yvette hesitated and shook her head.
The visitors exchanged glances, taken aback by the unexpected response.
"I see. Let me explain in detail..."

As the ice slowly melted, the gears of destiny began to turn.

StoryContent.SourceString:
在大众的眼中，香奈美的出身优越，她的父亲是行业里赫赫有名的理论物理学家，母亲则是出版了畅销小说的作家。香奈美在温馨开明的家庭氛围中成长，很早就显露出了舞台表演的天赋。
然而现实却是千差万别的，香奈美在家里从未获得过足够的关注。称之为父亲的男人只专注于研究的课题，称之为母亲的女人郁郁寡欢于自己写不出好作品，就连年长的哥哥也不过是在用成绩来博得父母的一点关爱。
年幼的香奈美经常会被托付给邻居或保姆，她只有在家庭聚餐日，才有机会与父母亲近。他们之间的情感仿佛是凝滞的，父母显然对于养育孩子感到无法适从。香奈美很自然地认为自己越懂事，父母就会越高兴，于是她变得很独立，尽量不给家里人添麻烦，就像是一个小大人。
“好像没有人会关注我……”独处的时候，香奈美经常会发出这样的疑问。
12岁那年，香奈美在网上偶然间看到了偶像练习生的选拔活动，她目不转睛地盯屏幕，站在聚光灯下的少女们被人群围绕着，那一句“抓住这次机会，让所有人看到你”一下子就击中了香奈美的心。
香奈美认真地填写了报名表，期盼着中选，只可惜几个月过去了，她没有收到任何回信。
StoryContent.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

StoryContent.SourceString:
直到某天放学回家的路上，一名来自艾顿娱乐的星探小姐找到了香奈美，她邀请香奈美加入偶像预备营。
此时香奈美并没有马上答应，她鼓起勇气问星探：“我明明已经落选了，为什么你还会来找我呢？”
星探卡蒂大笑着回答：“我恰巧看到了你之前的报名表，大部分人在偶像宣言那一栏只写了一两句话，而你却整整写满了一页。所以我猜想你应该比任何人都更渴望站上舞台吧？”
被说中心事的香奈美当即就羞红着脸逃开了，但是没过几天，她还是忍不住拨通了名片上的电话。至于后面的故事就很顺理成章了，她签约成为了练习生，开始了长达三年的艺能训练。
在这期间，有好多女孩为了能早点出道采用了组团的形式来争取机会，然而没有人邀请过香奈美。香奈美向已经升为主管的卡蒂请教原因，卡蒂直白地告诉她：“因为你太过于耀眼了，谁和你组团只会被沦为伴舞。”这是香奈美人生中第一次获得如此高的肯定，她愈发坚定了成为偶像的梦想。
15岁那年，香奈美参加了节目《公开试镜》，她凭借着“天真烂漫”的笑容迅速走红，最终以第一名的成绩出道。香奈美坐在了艾顿城上空的秋千上，对未来的演艺生涯有着无限的憧憬。
StoryContent.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

StoryContent.SourceString:
人们的关注是非常具有时效性的，这是香奈美进入演艺界学到的第一课。
《公开试镜》节目一播完，香奈美的热度就迅速降下去了。她即将要面对的是极为残酷的业界，和没有工作邀约的困境。
为了能让香奈美闯出一条道路，卡蒂担任了香奈美的经纪人，为她组建了运营团队，还找来了实力派歌手夏露担任香奈美的声乐老师。
出道的第一年，香奈美过得异常艰辛。她除了要接受高强度的唱跳训练之外，还会在经纪公司的安排下，去跑各种综艺节目的通告、出席小型商演活动、客串微电影和音乐MV中的小角色……
随着香奈美混迹在娱乐圈的时间越来越长，她已经能清晰地辨识复杂的人际关系，用一套灵活的方式去应对各种身份的人了。即使对方怀有敌意，她也能用笑容去轻松化解。
经过了整整两年的厚积薄发，香奈美的国民认知度终于打开了，她的迷你专辑也迎来了大火。特别是歌曲《心海》连续三个月都蝉联音乐网站人气歌曲排行榜的冠军，获得了钻石唱片等奖项。
香奈美被誉为甜美少女的代言人，闪耀在舞台上的一番星，艾顿娱乐公司也获得了足够的资金来为她举办巡回演唱会。
StoryContent.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

StoryContent.SourceString:
“初始”巡回演出期间发生过一个插曲，某次香奈美在进行跨城穿梭时，发生了由于飞行器系统故障导致的事故，使她迫降在了未知区域。附近的普雷顿管理中心在接收到香奈美的紧急呼救信号后，派出了救援队将她安置到了柯西街区。
香奈美在柯西街区见到了接待她的明，明表示自己是第一次见到偶像，心情特别激动。明热情地让香奈美住进了自家的客房，还带她去大吃了一顿。
香奈美以前了解到的普雷顿是由边缘人组建的垃圾城区，那些不思进取的人们企图与欧泊政府叫板，成立了一个极具威胁性的剪刀手组织……然而就香奈美的亲身体验来说，她感受到的是居民们的朴实，人与人相处的温情。
距离经纪公司专机抵达只剩三天的时候，香奈美自发地在普雷顿举办了小型义演。在演出的过程中，香奈美惊奇地发现台下有些人流泪了。事后，香奈美向明询问原因。明告诉香奈美那些人已经被欧泊的轮回计划抹去记忆了，流泪只是因为他们被歌声唤醒了一点零星的画面，可是谁又会为他们发声呢？
香奈美想起了曾经，想起了自己不被任何人关注的时光。她一时冲动跟明说道：“如果有需要，我也会成为你们的志愿者……”。
StoryContent.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

StoryContent.SourceString:
“初始”巡回演唱会圆满落幕了，香奈美也回到了艾顿城，继续依照顶流偶像的轨迹去工作和生活。
出乎香奈美意料的是明被调到了主城区执行任务，而且明会经常主动联系香奈美，香奈美也帮着明去打探过一些消息。这样一来二去，香奈美友好的态度让明误以为她真的愿意追随剪刀手组织。而实际上，香奈美处于一种被动答应的状态，但是她太擅长将这种矛盾的心理掩盖过去了。
作为曾经的透明人，香奈美对于普雷顿人们的事情无法坐视不管，但是她清楚地知道以自己的身份绝不能参与这种危险的事情。她多么希望可以出现一个人帮自己理清杂乱的思绪，为她找到处理问题的答案。
在一次爆破行动中，香奈美受了伤，剪刀手组织暂停了她后续的任务安排，让她好好休养一段时间再提交归队申请。
香奈美不知道这件事对她来说是幸运还是不幸，因为她本身就很迷茫，她难以把控自己的选择和生活。就连当初她被视为志愿者，由拉薇领着去挑选武器的时候，她也经历了内心的反复纠结，最终缓慢地拿起了狙击枪。在香奈美看来，狙击手的身份隐匿，待在不易被察觉的暗处，可以最快地转移位置……所以算是可行的吧。
我是谁？我在干什么？
香奈美需要先了解自己，才有可能真正明白战斗的意义。

StoryContent.SourceString:
绯莎从事佣兵工作有多久，她已记不清了。而唯一与她相伴多年的，只有狩猎时使用的枪械与匕首。
她不记得自己的父母是谁，没有家庭的概念。因为她不需要依靠父母就独自生活到了现在。
她也不记得是谁传授了她一身战斗本领。也许她曾有一个师傅，亦或许没有。
这些事情对她来说毫不重要，她也没有兴趣了解或思考。
有委托了她就便执行委托，并一丝不苟地按照雇主的要求解决猎物。
除了专业高效，绯莎在保密方面也非常让雇主们放心。她一度成为行会里好评数、订单数最多的佣兵。
尽管见惯了各种阴暗混乱的场面，但她对人类之间的纠纷恩怨毫无兴趣，也从不过问。
人类在她眼中只有两类，猎物（对手亦等同于猎物），以及其他人。
干杀手这一行当，要么成为猎人，要么就沦为猎物。
所以对于绯莎来说，她最感兴趣的是如何变得更强大的，其他的都不重要。这就是佣兵绯莎的活法。

StoryContent.SourceString:
执行任务时，绯莎习惯用代号称呼自己，并按照她的心情随时替换。
“鲨鱼”是她最有名的一个代号。她的一身本领被乌尔比诺看上之后，她的新雇主们就一直叫她“鲨鱼”。
“鲨鱼？那是什么？”
“一种很古老而罕见的海洋生物。”
“为什么是鲨鱼？”
“因为你很像鲨鱼啊，你不这么觉得吗？”
这是绯莎第一次有其他事物产生联系，而她原本的名字“绯莎”在她的印象里是一种植物的名字，为什么这名雇主会说她像鲨鱼呢？
她莫名地想知道其中的缘由，这算是绯莎为数不多感兴趣的琐事。
与大多数生物一样，鲨鱼还没有适应新世界的环境，活生生的鲨鱼普通人几乎没有机会见到。
而绯莎只通过文字、图片或商品了解这种陌生的生物。
她知道有一种很流行的鲨鱼零食叫甜甜鲨，轻巧便携，能够快速补充能量，这是她除了巧克力和鲷鱼烧之外，最喜欢的食物。
还有一种鲨鱼形状的整蛊玩具，被称作“咬人鲨”，每次路过玩具店，绯莎都会都驻足研究一番（如果有哪个委托的报酬是咬人鲨玩具，绯莎或许会立刻接下）。
但真正的鲨鱼是一种尖头尖尾、面目狰狞的海洋生物，她很难将自己与这种遥远而陌生的生物联系起来。
寻解未果的绯莎决定亲自去问一问那名雇主。
StoryContent.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

StoryContent.SourceString:
“嗯……大概是因为你和鲨鱼的生存方式很像吧。”
……但是，如何相像呢？
面对绯莎的追问，这名雇主稍微耐心地解释了一番——
“鲨鱼对‘血’的味道天生敏感，一旦猎物负伤就无法摆脱鲨鱼的追捕。从这个角度来说，你不就是一条鲨鱼么？”
不，并非如此。鲨鱼是为了自己而狩猎，而绯莎从来都不是，毕竟鲨鱼不需要在凌晨三点被叫起来执行任务。
绯莎听到这种说法时，心里第一次产生了不快。
尽管无亲无故，以“狩猎”为生，但绯莎清楚地知道，自己是一个人类，而不是嗜血的怪物。
在她的内心深处，也有隐藏着对“平静生活”的想象：
睡觉睡到自然醒，然后把那个喜欢吃薯片的对手约出来对打，直到决胜出谁才是真正的强者；
或者，把影像店所有的武打片打包租回家，把音量开到最大，吃着鲷鱼烧看上一整天。顺带一提，武打片是绯莎学习战斗美学的重要渠道。
故而，绯莎追求的“平静”，并非远离战斗，而是让战斗无处不在、充满自己的生活。
不过，鲨鱼的生活会是什么样的？或许，鲨鱼也有属于自己的“平静生活”？
StoryContent.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

StoryContent.SourceString:
“喂，别吃了……我问你，你了解鲨鱼吗？”
某一次，绯莎主动找到了那个爱吃薯片的对手，不过这回她吃的是仙贝。
“好像在拉薇的书上看到过，怎么了？”
“有人说我跟鲨鱼很像……我想知道原因。”
“所以，你打算怎么做呢？”
“我想见见鲨鱼，想和它聊聊。”
“但鲨鱼可不会说话，就像大多数动物一样。而且，我觉得你不像鲨鱼。”
对方的说法令绯莎倍感震惊，因为一直以来，她都把鲨鱼当作是自己的同伴，是与自己最为相近的“同类”。
“为、为什么不像……？”
“因为这个世界的鲨鱼几乎都被关在水族箱里，时间久了，不再接触海洋，它们就会慢慢丢失自己的嗅觉。”
鲨鱼……丢失了嗅觉？
“但你不一样，你是嗅觉非常出色的猎人，来去自如。所以，我说你不像鲨鱼。”
鲨鱼不是同类？难道自己被雇主骗了吗？
对手的说法令绯莎耿耿于怀，她决定亲自探寻答案。
听对手说，鲨鱼这样没能适应环境的生物被严格保存在欧泊的管辖之下。
在一次任务中，绯莎依照雇主的要求秘密潜入欧泊的科研基地——
不，倒不如说是绯莎主动揽下这个委托，她一直在暗中窥探能够见到鲨鱼的机会。
StoryContent.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

StoryContent.SourceString:
有情报称，在一个科研基地里秘密保存着一条活的鲨鱼。
虽然还是在熟悉的凌晨三点，但这次绯莎的工作热情显著提升。她顺着情报给出的坐标，顺利找到了那个困住了她“同类”的水箱——
隔着冰冷的玻璃，两条“鲨鱼”互相凝望，但对方却在黑暗的水箱里一言不发。
鲨鱼确实不会说话，对手的第一个说法被印证了。那么嗅觉呢？绯莎迫切地想验证第二个说法。
但在此时，绯莎的行踪暴露，雇主也给绯莎发来撤离的指令。带着遗憾与一丝丝孤独，绯莎不舍地告别了鲨鱼。
在完成那次任务之后，绯莎主动找到正在街舞机上扭动的老板，要求对方把那条鲨鱼搞到手。
为此绯莎愿意拿出自己的全部积蓄，但贵为商业精英的老板却极为罕见地面露难色……
其他雇主也是一样，没一个人能帮到自己，绯莎对此非常失望。她重复着日复一日的委托，她本以为自己也无法走出水箱……但在某次狩猎中，意外降临了：一个奇怪的人出现，意外地打败了自己，并做出了一个有趣的承诺。
绯莎无法用已有的两个分类概括这个人，她单独为其开设了一个新的分类。
在那个承诺中，她看到了一丝实现“平静生活”的希望。
也许是时候告别凌晨三点被老板叫醒、被强劲音乐打扰的生活了……
她决定向那个人投递一封求职信。
在写信的时候，她好像看到，水箱里的鲨鱼正在一点点地向洒满阳光的水面游去。
StoryContent.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!
